title: Audition Gate — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Audition Gate's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.file: Audition Gate — rich — both pass the spec.m4a
pieces.title: Both pass the spec
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* The three figures were read off the saved wav and agree to two decimals (-12.87 dB each); the m4a made from it may read a tenth of a decibel off. Other measurements do tell the notes apart (the second note's level swings 6 dB and its brightness sweeps; the first holds still), and so do the traces in the picture. Whether one sounds dead is a claim about listening, and nobody has listened. *Leaking in:* Generative Audio Devices: 'structurally correct and audibly inert'. Audition Gate does not link it.
